subject: POC: prompt & eval dataset collection - AcmeCorp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@acmecorp.com>; Bob Stevens <bob.stevens@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-01T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: POC kickoff - prompt & eval dataset collection (post-call recap)

Thanks for your time today — great conversation. Per our call, outlined below is the POC data collection checklist and next steps so we can start building the eval set and run initial quality checks on Redwood Dedicated.

1) Success criteria (please confirm):
   - 85% accept rate on intent classification/response appropriateness across core flows
   - Latency target: 95th percentile under 400ms for 1-2 token streaming scenarios
   - No sensitive PII in supplied examples (we'll redact as needed; see security note)

2) Evaluation artifacts we need from AcmeCorp by Wed 2027-05-05:
   - Representative prompt set (spreadsheet + sample raw logs): acmecorp_prompts_v1.xlsx
   - 2 weeks of anonymized chat logs (chat_logs_202704.zip)
   - Ground-truth labels for ~500 examples (if available) or a short rubric for labeling

3) Ownership & timelines:
   - AcmeCorp: provide prompts + logs (Alice) — target 2027-05-05
   - Redwood: ingest, sample, and initial eval plan (Marissa/Aditya) — target 2027-05-07
   - Joint review of eval results and go/no-go decision — meeting week of 2027-05-10

4) Security/compliance: we'll provide a short checklist for secure transfer (S3 pre-signed URL or secure SharePoint). If anything must remain on-prem, let us know.

Action items: Alice to upload the two files to the Drive link or share via S3; I'll send the eval template and labeling rubric tomorrow.

Thanks — Marissa
---
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: POC kickoff - prompt & eval dataset collection (post-call recap)

Thanks, Marissa — this looks right to me. Quick clarifications:

- Success criteria: the 85% accept rate is fine as a starting point; our internal product team will validate if we need to adjust for edge flows.
- We'll provide a sample of 750 prompts/turns and two weeks of anonymized chat logs. There will be customer IDs in logs that we need to pseudonymize; I'll remove direct PII before upload.
- Preferred transfer: S3 presigned (we have a short-lived upload process). I will share creds with your infra contact if needed.

I'll aim to get the prompt spreadsheet and logs uploaded by EOD Tuesday 2027-05-04.

— Alice
Alice Johnson
Head of Product, AcmeCorp

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-05-02T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff - prompt & eval dataset collection (post-call recap)

Hi Alice — thanks for the confirmation. A couple of technical notes from our side to make ingestion smoother:

- Prompts: prefer a CSV/Excel with columns: id, user_message, system_prompt (if used), expected_output/label, intent (optional). If you have conversation context, include a thread_id column.
- Chat logs: if you can provide JSONL per-turn that's ideal; otherwise a zipped CSV is fine. Please include timestamps and anonymized user ids.
- Labeling: if you can't provide ground-truth for all 750, send a 200-sample gold set and we'll sample the rest for human labeling with your rubric.

I'll create an S3 presigned upload and share it by EOD today. Neha will coordinate the labeling batch and QA.

Thanks — Aditya
